about: Lane SIG12 (2026-11-27, owner priority 1, most-seen first): three gaps an existing recipe could not show without scene code, no new clips. (1) Communal roosts in the species' own colours: the African grey parrot (8 aboard), the eared dove (6), the blue-fronted amazon (5) and the galah (5) roost communally (`roost_gather`, their own sleep text below); the roost-mates are drawn in the colours of the species' own model skin (`herd-specks.ts` textureTones; before, every roost crowd was dark or brown), and a roost in a crown sits on the crown's top where the camera sees it (`behaviour-recipes.ts` crownPerches), not inside the leaves. (2) The house gecko (36 aboard) perched on its lamp wall hunts by sit-and-wait in its hours (`index.ts` perchAmbushOf: the micro path's bout, `micro-ambush.ts`, on the wall's plane); its `pounce~lizard` row is released from data/ark/signature-holds.json. The leopard gecko's row stays held: its text is a ground hunter at burrow mouths, never perched on a wall (see `notes`). (3) The black-headed gull (4 aboard, the town's) roosts afloat on open water at night: its night roost is the nearest open water's surface within 120 m (`src/ark-scene/roost-afloat.json`, its own sleep sentence; `behaviour-schedule.ts` afloatRoost), where it is drawn at its float line on the water; it slept on the grass by a house wall before.
